_comment: Atlas Growth :: US residential concrete contractors (driveways / patios / stamped), Google Maps, nationwide, WARM STATES FIRST (ICP-concrete.md; operator STEP 1 answers 2026-11-12). Engine config for google-maps-scrape. Job-specific values live ONLY here. Qualification is LENIENT (operator 2026-11-12, same as pools): open, US, no review floor, no website requirement; the universe is cut by type/name denies here and the real fit verdict comes from the site-text gate (STEP 5e, classify-prompt.md of the run). This is a SEPARATE config from atlas-growth-concrete-config.json, which the 2026-11-11 Yellow Pages probe's scripts reference and which has no scrape/qualify blocks.

categories._r: STEP 2: the ONLY native pour-crew category is 'Concrete contractor' (references/google-maps-categories.md). Its siblings - Cement manufacturer, Cement supplier, Concrete factory, Concrete product supplier, Concrete metal framework supplier, Ready mix concrete supplier, Masonry contractor, Masonry supply store, Paving contractor, Paving materials supplier - are the adjacent-but-wrong set (suppliers/plants) or adjacent trades; they feed the deny/allow lists below. The three keyword rows (P3, kw:concrete) are fuzzy-matched on names/descriptions and routed to classify when the allow-list drops them (STEP 5b keyword recovery).

scrape_tuning._r: Same settings as the US generator run (measured ~2.1-2.6 Maps calls per runsheet row). paginate:true pages each viewport via offset; max_pages 6 x limit 150 caps a dense metro; max_depth 1 = at most one quadrant split.

_no_review_floor: Operator 2026-11-12: LENIENT. No review_count floor; review_count stays a column. Calibration 2026-11-12: 654 of 780 rows carried one.
_no_website_rule: Deliberately NO {website, exists} rule: collapse-domains.js routes no-website and shared-host rows to the STEP 5d recovery track after the denies have run (calibration: 73-78% of rows have a website).

brand_families._r: Flag-only (keep every branch, flag the brand). Unverified list carried from the YP probe config; matched as lowercase substrings of '<name> <root_domain>'.

owner_query._r: Keenable backend (engine, 2026-11-11): KEENABLE_API_KEY in the skill .env; --max-calls is required on every run. DataForSEO has no credentials on this machine.

qualify_rules._r: 1. Must-drop PRIMARY types (operator 2026-11-12): material suppliers, plants, factories, big-box / retail, equipment rental. Primary-only on purpose: a contractor carrying an incidental supplier tag survives to the site-text gate. Substring-matched, so every term is multi-word or unambiguous (IMPROVEMENTS: short deny terms delete whole ICPs). Seen as primaries in the 2026-11-12 calibration: 'Ready mix concrete supplier' 21/780, 'Concrete product supplier' 2, 'Concrete metal framework supplier' 1, 'Building materials store' 1.
qualify_rules.label: off_icp_type

qualify_rules._r: 2. Must-drop by NAME (fires on primary or secondary type): big-box and rental chains, cement / ready-mix majors and bagged-mix brands, ready-mix plants, civic bodies. Every term is multi-word or a distinctive brand (substring trap).
qualify_rules.label: name_deny

qualify_rules._r: 3. Positive allow on google_types-ANY (never primary): any concrete / masonry / paving / driveway-ish tag. Calibration ANY-tag counts: Concrete contractor 524, Masonry contractor 88, Paving contractor 78, Asphalt contractor 26, Stucco contractor 14, Bricklayer 8. Rows with none of these (a 'Construction company' / 'General contractor' / 'Landscaper' / 'Contractor' primary with no concrete tag) are dropped here as not_in_icp and come back two ways at $0: (a) keyword rows (icp_type kw:concrete) go to classify per SKILL STEP 5b keyword recovery; (b) generic contractor/landscaper types whose NAME claims concrete are re-admitted by recover-generic-concrete-config.json.
qualify_rules.label: not_in_icp
